brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net a website that recreates the avatar as a QR code that links to the website hosted on that domain. if the domain doesn't point to a website return the clown emojii
the QR code should be high contrast but look as much like the avatar as possible
note: qrface: type a handle, get the avatar as a scannable halftone QR to its domain; no website there and you get 🤡. Worker only checks if the domain answers.
